evidence.source_paraphrase: For the GJ 1132-derived SED, the authors generated models with XUV flux and escape rate at 1% to 33% of their respective fiducial values; the Figure 4 caption explicitly says that escape rate was assumed proportional to XUV flux relative to the best-fitting 2024 model.
evidence.reasoning: With relative_xuv_flux defined as XUV flux divided by its fiducial value, the stated proportionality and fiducial normalization give atmospheric_escape_rate = fiducial_escape_rate × relative_xuv_flux. The card encodes a reported model-input assumption, not an empirical causal law, and its applicability text preserves that status.
